claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows the PlayStation logo and Sony branding on the shell.
Photo 0 describes the original vertical design with white outer shells and a black center.
The region of origin cannot be determined from external photos.
Photo 0 shows one wireless controller at the base.

risks.risk: The console may be the Digital Edition (no disc drive).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the front/side profile to check for a disc slot.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or output video via HDMI.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the dashboard on a TV.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logged into a PSN account.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or faulty buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate menus.

proof_requests: Photo of the front of the console showing the presence or absence of a disc slot.
Video of the console powered on and displaying the home screen.
Photo of the rear ports to check for damage.
response.reason: The item is identified as a PlayStation 5. It is priced at the worst-case value of a non-functional Digital Edition until proof of operation and a disc drive is provided.
